summary: URLgenius launched Claude and ChatGPT integrations (via MCP) so clients can build app links inside AI tools, plus Creator Trends, a daily view of products its creators are promoting.
YouTube Shopping keeps expanding abroad: Dubai launched a programme to help 1,000 creators earn commissions, and a Vietnam case study shows Shopping GMV up 326% in three months.
Skimlinks shared UK network data showing Black Friday sales value hit 4x an average October day last year; Bitly is pitching creator click tracking against a projected $37B in US creator spend.
Goodreads Choice Awards voting opened (10 to 22 Nov). Lasso, Button/Posttap and Amazon's link tools had no new link-tool news (Amazon's Black Friday dates ran yesterday).
